definition: used before a noun to mean one, when it is not a specific one

collocations.example: She wants a job with a good salary.
We spent a lot of money on repairs.

definition: having the skill, power, or chance to do something

collocations.example: We were able to finish the report on time.
She is an able employee who handles pressure well.

definition: on the subject of something; concerning something

collocations.example: We need to talk about the budget tomorrow.
She was worried about the test results.

definition: in or to a higher position than something

collocations.example: The plane flew high above the city.
The mountain peak rose above the clouds.

definition: complete and total

collocations.example: The dictator held absolute power over the country.
The library demands absolute silence from all visitors.

definition: to agree to take something that is offered to you

collocations.example: She decided to accept the job offer quickly.
She was glad to accept the invitation.

definition: from one side to the other side of something

collocations.example: They built a bridge across the wide river.
We had to walk across the busy road.

definition: to do something, especially to deal with a problem

collocations.example: We must act quickly to solve the problem.
The team acted on the customer's feedback.

definition: real and exact, not just guessed or imagined

collocations.example: The actual cost was higher than our estimate.
Please show me the actual figures for sales.

definition: to put something with something else to make it larger

collocations.example: Add a little sugar to the tea.
Please add my name to the list.

definition: the details of the place where someone lives or receives mail

collocations.example: Please write your home address on the form.
Can you give me your email address please?

definition: to agree that something bad or difficult is true

collocations.example: She was brave enough to admit her mistake.
The team refused to admit defeat so easily.

definition: to tell people about a product or job to encourage sales

collocations.example: They spent a lot to advertise the new product.
The company will advertise the job online next week.

definition: to have enough money or time to pay for something

collocations.example: I can afford to take a short holiday.
She can barely afford the monthly rent now.

definition: feeling fear or worry that something bad may happen

collocations.example: Many people are afraid of public speaking.
She was afraid to ask for more help.

definition: later in time than something

collocations.example: We will meet again after lunch today.
The guests left soon after the dinner ended.

definition: the time of day from noon until the evening

collocations.example: The delivery should arrive in the afternoon.
Our afternoon meeting was moved to three o'clock.

definition: one more time, as before

collocations.example: Please try again if the first attempt fails.
Once again, the train was late this morning.

definition: in opposition to someone, something, or an idea

collocations.example: Most members voted against the new proposal.
Smoking here is against the company rules.

definition: how old a person or thing is

collocations.example: She retired at the age of sixty.
He stayed active well into old age.

definition: back in the past from now

collocations.example: They moved to this city years ago.
That little shop closed down long ago.

definition: to have the same opinion as another person

collocations.example: I fully agree with your main point.
The two sides could not agree on a price.

definition: in front of someone, or further forward in time

collocations.example: Good leaders look ahead to next year.
Smart managers always plan ahead for busy seasons.

definition: the gas around us that people and animals breathe

collocations.example: Let's open a window for some fresh air.
A strange smell hung in the air.

definition: the whole number or amount of something

collocations.example: All of the tickets were sold within hours.
He complains about the noise all the time.

definition: to let someone do something or let something happen

collocations.example: The pass will allow access to all floors.
Visitors are not allowed in this area.

definition: very nearly but not quite

collocations.example: Almost all the seats were already taken.
The morning train is almost always on time.

definition: without any other person present

collocations.example: Many older people choose to live alone.
She felt all alone in the new office.

definition: following the length of a road, path, or line

collocations.example: We like to walk along the river.
We stopped for coffee along the way.

definition: by this time, or sooner than expected

collocations.example: The report is already done and sent.
I already know the results of the test.

definition: fine, safe, or good enough; not bad

collocations.example: Do you feel alright after the long trip?
Everything will turn out alright in the end.

definition: in addition; as well as something else

collocations.example: The price also includes free delivery.
The hotel also offers a free breakfast.

definition: used to show a contrast; in spite of something

collocations.example: Although we tried hard, we missed the deadline.
Although tired, she finished the whole project.

definition: at all times, or every time something happens

collocations.example: Our support team is always ready to help.
He is always late for the morning meeting.

definition: surrounded by or in the middle of a group

collocations.example: The app is popular among young users.
She felt relaxed among her close friends.

definition: a quantity of something, especially how much there is

collocations.example: The project needs a large amount of money.
Please check the total amount on the invoice.

definition: used to connect words, phrases, or sentences

collocations.example: We sell pens, paper, folders, and so on.
She finished lunch and then returned to work.

definition: having strong feelings of displeasure about something

collocations.example: She was angry with him for being late.
Try not to get angry over small things.

definition: a living thing that can move, not a plant

collocations.example: The park protects many kinds of wild animals.
She joined a group that supports animal rights.

definition: one more, or a different one of the same type

collocations.example: Could I have another one of those cookies?
The problems came one after another all day.

definition: something you say or write when replying to a question

collocations.example: She quickly gave the right answer.
The manager gave a clear answer to everyone.

definition: some amount or number; it does not matter which one

collocations.example: You can call me at any time.
Did any of the guests arrive early?

definition: separated, or into separate pieces

collocations.example: The old chair began to fall apart.
He had to take apart the machine to fix it.

definition: easy to notice or understand; clearly seen

collocations.example: The problem soon became apparent to everyone.
He left the meeting for no apparent reason.

definition: to start to be seen or to become visible

collocations.example: The results will appear on the screen soon.
His name will appear on the final list.

definition: a particular part of a place, town, or country

collocations.example: They live in a quiet residential area.
Are there good schools in the area?

definition: the long body part between the shoulder and the hand

collocations.example: He broke his arm during the football game.
The couple walked arm in arm through the park.

definition: on every side of something, or in a circle

collocations.example: Take time to look around the new office.
Tall trees stood all around the house.

definition: to make plans so that something can happen

collocations.example: Let's arrange a meeting for next Tuesday.
I will arrange for a taxi to collect you.

definition: to reach a place at the end of a journey

collocations.example: We should arrive at the airport by noon.
The guests all managed to arrive on time.

definition: the activity of making paintings, drawings, or sculptures

collocations.example: The museum has a large modern art collection.
This painting is a true work of art.

definition: used to show the role, job, or purpose of someone

collocations.example: She works as a nurse in the city.
As a child, she loved to read.

definition: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something you did

collocations.example: He was ashamed of his rude behavior.
There is no need to feel ashamed about asking.

definition: to say words to get information or a reply

collocations.example: Feel free to ask a question at any time.
A tourist stopped to ask the way.

definition: used to show an exact place, time, or point

collocations.example: She prefers to work at home on Fridays.
They both arrived at the same time.

definition: the sister of your mother or father

collocations.example: My aunt lives near the city center.
We stayed with my aunt and uncle.

definition: the season between summer and winter, when leaves fall

collocations.example: The trees lose their leaves in autumn.
We walked through the golden autumn leaves.

definition: knowing about something because you have noticed it

collocations.example: She was aware of the risks involved.
We slowly became aware of the problem.

definition: to or at a distance from a person or place

collocations.example: Their new house is quite far away.
The pain should go away after a rest.

definition: very bad, unpleasant, or of poor quality

collocations.example: We had awful weather during the whole trip.
She felt sick and looked awful this morning.

definition: a very young child who cannot yet walk or talk

collocations.example: They are excited to have a baby soon.
The nurse gently held the newborn baby.

definition: returning to an earlier place, position, or condition

collocations.example: We need to go back to the office.
Please come back before it gets dark.

definition: not good; unpleasant or of poor quality

collocations.example: The manager had to share some bad news.
The flight was delayed by bad weather.

definition: a soft container used to carry or hold things

collocations.example: She filled her shopping bag with groceries.
Please reuse this plastic bag if you can.

definition: a round object used for playing sports and games

collocations.example: He ran forward to kick the ball hard.
The dog chased the yellow tennis ball.

definition: a business where people keep, borrow, and save money

collocations.example: She opened a new bank account yesterday.
They repaid the bank loan within five years.

definition: a place or counter where drinks are sold and served

collocations.example: They sat at the bar and ordered drinks.
We met for a drink at the hotel bar.

definition: the lowest part of something, on which it stands

collocations.example: Water collected at the base of the wall.
The company built a solid base for growth.

definition: simplest and most important; forming a starting point

collocations.example: The charity provides food and other basic needs.
The job requires basic knowledge of computers.

definition: the act of washing the body in a tub of water

collocations.example: She likes to take a bath before bed.
A hot bath helped him relax after work.

definition: used to show existence, a state, or a quality

collocations.example: We hope to be able to help you soon.
Please be careful on the wet floor.

definition: the area of sand or small stones beside the sea

collocations.example: The children played happily on the beach.
The resort has a long sandy beach.

definition: to accept or put up with something difficult or painful

collocations.example: The loss was very hard to bear.
He cannot bear long meetings in the afternoon.

definition: to defeat someone in a game, race, or competition

collocations.example: Our club beat the top team last night.
Their low prices are hard to beat.

definition: the quality of being very attractive or pleasing to look at

collocations.example: Visitors admire the natural beauty of the valley.
The garden is a place of great beauty.

definition: for the reason that; used to explain why

collocations.example: The game was canceled because of the rain.
She left early because she felt unwell.

definition: to begin to be something, or to change into something

collocations.example: The app quickly became popular among students.
You can become a member for free online.

definition: a piece of furniture that you sleep on

collocations.example: The children go to bed at eight.
He stayed in bed with a bad cold.

definition: earlier than a particular time or event

collocations.example: The project will be finished before long.
She arrived the day before the big event.

definition: to start doing something or start to happen

collocations.example: Let's begin with a quick review of sales.
People began to leave before the end.

definition: at or toward the back of someone or something

collocations.example: The car was right behind us the whole way.
The broom is behind the kitchen door.

definition: to feel sure that something is true or real

collocations.example: I believe that she is telling the truth.
It is hard to believe the news is true.

definition: in a lower place or position than something else

collocations.example: This month's sales were below average.
The temperature dropped below zero last night.

definition: in or to a lower position than something; under it

collocations.example: Many problems lay hidden beneath the surface.
They found old coins beneath the wooden floor.

definition: at the side of someone or something; next to

collocations.example: She asked me to sit beside her.
They parked the car beside the road.

definition: of the highest quality; better than all the rest

collocations.example: She is my best friend from college.
This is the best way to save money.

definition: to risk money on the result of a game or event

collocations.example: He likes to bet on horse races.
He bet ten dollars on the final match.

definition: of a higher standard or quality than another

collocations.example: This phone is better than my old one.
Careful planning gives a better result.

definition: in the space, time, or range that separates two things

collocations.example: There is strong trust between the two partners.
Try not to snack between meals.

definition: on the far side of something, or more than a limit

collocations.example: His talent is beyond doubt to everyone here.
The goal now seems beyond our reach.

definition: large in size, amount, or importance

collocations.example: Tokyo is a very big city.
They bought a big house in the suburbs.

definition: a written note showing how much money you must pay

collocations.example: Let me pay the bill for dinner tonight.
My phone bill was higher than usual.

definition: the number 1,000,000,000; one thousand million

collocations.example: The company is now worth over a billion dollars.
The galaxy holds billions of bright stars.

definition: an animal with feathers and wings that usually can fly

collocations.example: They put out seeds for the wild birds.
We woke to cheerful bird song this morning.

definition: the event of a baby coming out into the world

collocations.example: She gave birth to a healthy baby.
Please write your date of birth here.

definition: a small amount or a small piece of something

collocations.example: Can I have a bit of your time?
I am a little bit tired tonight.

definition: of the darkest color, like coal or the night sky

collocations.example: Black smoke poured from the burning building.
He polished his black leather shoes.

definition: the red liquid that the heart pumps around the body

collocations.example: The doctor checked his blood pressure carefully.
She had a blood test at the clinic.

definition: to send out air, or to be pushed by moving air

collocations.example: She blew out all the birthday candles.
He blew gently on the hot soup.

definition: having the color of a clear sky or the deep sea

collocations.example: We enjoyed the clear blue sky all day.
He wore a dark blue suit to work.
